_meta.purpose: Tuning config for experimental bundle formula. Read by 7x_spawn_template.py _assemble_experimental_bundle(). Do not hand-edit tokens — token counts are computed at assemble time from actual file reads.

tuning_knobs.hesitation_signal: hesitation before recommendation triggers droplet re-read

notes: Experimental formula is gated to explorer, synthesizer, architect, knowledge-synthesizer, research-analyst by agent-routing-policy.json.
Forensics, evidence, coc-manager agents are ALWAYS conservative — this config never applies to them.
Token budget math: sum of component budgets (2000+2500+1200+800) = 6500 + 1200 overhead = 7700 soft floor; 10K hard cap.
Target 9.7K was specified in task; achieved by tuning NECTAR_lines=50 vs conservative tail-30.
Hesitation trigger is a behavioral signal, not a runtime gate — injected as an instruction into the bundle text.
